related_questions.question: How do I find out who owns a property in Ohio?
related_questions.snippet: Understanding Property Ownership in Ohio Property changes hands sometimes very quickly. If you need to find the current homeowner of a piece of real property, the best way to do so is to contact the local county recorder's office. They should have the most current deed on file and can tell you who owns the property.

related_questions.question: How to find property tax in Ohio?
related_questions.title: Calculate Real Property Taxes
list: To compute the taxable or assessed value, multiply the market value (1) times 35%.
To compute the gross taxes, divide the taxable rate ($81.45) by 1000 and multiply the factor by the taxable value ($35,000).
